# Fleetezee — Technology for Modern Transportation
> Fleetezee is a transportation technology company building digital infrastructure, intelligent cloud workflows, and modern operating systems for the businesses that move goods.

## Company & Flagship Platform
- **Organization**: Fleetezee Technologies Pvt Ltd
- **Mission**: Building the digital infrastructure for modern transportation.
- **Flagship Platform**: TruckBill ERP (Comprehensive transport operations and billing operating system)
- **Primary Functionality**: Automates digital LR (Lorry Receipt / Bilty) generation, trip dispatch & vehicle allocation, market vehicle broker settlements, diesel pump slip reconciliation, driver advances & passbooks, FASTag toll audits, customer GST billing, and Section 194C TDS compliance.
- **Geographic Coverage**: Pan-India (Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, JNPT, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, Indore, Ludhiana, Jaipur, Hyderabad).
- **Official Website**: https://fleetezee.com/
- **Flagship Portal**: https://www.truckbill.in/
- **Contact Line**: +91 98200 00000
- **Email**: fleetezee@gmail.com
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

## Flagship Platform: TruckBill ERP (12 Specialized Operational Modules)
1. **Digital LR & Bilty Engine**: Auto-sequenced LRs aligning with pre-printed stationery, multi-item details, GST tax rates, and WhatsApp PDF dispatch.
2. **Trip Dispatch & Vehicle Allocation**: Allocate own fleet, attached trucks, or market broker vehicles with verified loading slips.
3. **Market Vehicle & Broker Settlement**: Calculate lorry hire rate vs party freight rate, diesel slip advances, cash deductions, and broker commission.
4. **Customer Invoicing & TDS Management**: Single or multi-LR tax invoices with detention charges and automated Section 194C TDS (1% or 2%) calculation.
5. **Diesel & FASTag Audit**: Pump slip reconciliation, toll debits, route mileage audit, and en-route cash vouchers.
6. **Mobile POD Capture**: Driver smartphone photo upload of physically stamped Proof of Delivery to unblock customer payment submission.
7. **Transport Accounting & Khata**: Double-entry party ledgers, broker khata, driver passbook, and cash books tailored to Indian transport customs.
8. **Vehicle-Wise Net Profit & Loss**: Track revenue, fuel costs, driver wages, maintenance, and EMI per truck every month.
9. **Driver Trip Passbook**: Driver trip allowances, route advances, and proof of delivery tracking to prevent disputes.
10. **Permit, Fitness & Insurance Alerts**: Proactive automated expiry alerts for commercial vehicle documents via WhatsApp and SMS.
11. **Multi-Branch Hierarchy**: Centralized head office visibility over booking branches and delivery hubs across India.
12. **WhatsApp Business Intelligence**: Automated delivery of LRs, tracking links, POD copies, and invoice payment reminders.

## Target Segments
- **Transport Contractors & FTL Agencies**: Corporate contract rates, multi-LR monthly invoicing, detention billing, and POD dispatch tracking.
- **Fleet Owners (Own Commercial Trucks)**: Vehicle P&L, diesel mileage audit, driver advances, FASTag reconciliation, and document expiries.
- **Commission Agents & Freight Brokers**: Dual-rate lorry vouchers, commission margin locks, supplier TDS compliance, and broker khata.
- **Logistics Hubs & Depots**: Multi-branch transshipment hubs, depot inventory, and cross-docking visibility.

## Technology Architecture & Standards
- **Event-Driven Distributed Backend**: High concurrency handling millions of transaction states during peak market dispatch hours.
- **Sub-100ms API Latency**: Rapid response times across all web and mobile endpoints.
- **WhatsApp Cloud API Integration**: Direct document delivery without third-party delay.
- **Offline-Tolerant Capture**: Resilient mobile data capture at remote loading docks with intermittent network connectivity.
- **Enterprise Security**: 256-bit TLS encryption, role-based branch permissions, and hourly cloud backups.

## Indian Compliance & Localization
- **GST Compliance**: Support for Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) & Forward Charge Mechanism (FCM).
- **Income Tax**: Automated Section 194C TDS deduction (1% individual/HUF, 2% company) and Pan-10 truck declaration recordkeeping.
- **E-Way Bill**: E-Way bill number tracking and portal compatibility.
- **FASTag & Fuel**: Direct toll and petrol pump slip reconciliation.
